beats.summary: Characters joke about nicknames 'T-Dog' and 'tuna dog'.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Nope, he means tuna dog.

beats.summary: Andy describes a surreal scenario involving Robert California demanding to fly a plane to Cuba and bomb Texas.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I thought the plane was flying pretty well on auto-pilot. And then Robert California ran into the cockpit with a gun and he was like "Fly this plane to Cuba, and on the way bomb Texas"

beats.summary: Erin offers to talk things over with Andy and suggests sharing ideas to double profits.

evidence.snippet: Erin: Hey. Maybe it'd help to just talk it over. Over a cup of cool old tea.
Erin: What if you were to just start with your ideas about how to double profits. Just say them all and maybe one of them will rise to the top.

beats.summary: Andy admits he has no ideas to double profits.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I don't have any ideas though.

beats.summary: Erin suggests Dunder Mifflin take on foster kids to get government checks and create a fun environment.

evidence.snippet: Erin: What if Dunder Mifflin were to take on 15-20 foster kids? You'd get huge checks from the government and honestly they would be ecstatic to live in the warehouse. It would be like Hogwart's.
Andy: Yeah…I don't think that's legal. It's a nice thought though.

beats.summary: Erin gives Andy a congratulatory gift, a red mouse cat toy key chain, and Andy appreciates being congratulated.

evidence.snippet: Erin: I just wanted to say congratulations on your new job, officially.
Andy: You're the only person who's congratulated me.
